title: Recommended NERO Gripper Collision Architecture v1

scope.analysis: Source-derived concrete closed convex entity partition, finite-precision and exact geometry verification; geometry only, not runtime acceptance

geometry_template.index_definition: Source STL zero-based file triangle order; visual OBJ zero-based f-line order with process=False. Do not substitute sorted triangles or compiled mesh principal axes.
geometry_template.point_source: Exact points/normals recover directly from the sealed STL triangles. Planar boundary loops retained below; no source asset duplicated.

topology.note: Numerical seam equivalence is analysis only; original coordinates and files unmodified. Inventory coverage is not closed-solid or external-surface certification.

recommended_components.recommended_primitive_family: Frozen source-derived convex_polyhedron partition; individual vertices/faces and semantic names in authoritative JSON
recommended_components.physical_role: Primary inward contact candidate; preserve full nonconvex 23-vertex footprint and genuine taper/root notches
